footer.tagline: farm machines and skilled workers, closer to your field

home.title: Farm machines and skilled workers, right in your village
home.subtitle: Rent a tractor, harvester or drone sprayer by the hour, day or acre. Hire a driver or operator with it. Results are sorted by real road distance from your farm.
home.heroAlt: Tractor on a farm in Coorg
home.step1: Use GPS or pick your village. We show machines and workers sorted by road distance.
home.step2: Pick the date and hours. Add a driver to the same booking if you need one.
home.step3: The owner accepts within two hours, then you get their phone number. Pay them in cash or UPI on the day.
